sql:
WITH disc_orders AS (
  SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.tenant_id, o.user_id, o.currency_code, o.placed_at,
         o.subtotal, o.discount_total, o.tax_total, o.shipping_total, o.grand_total
  FROM order_discounts od
  JOIN discounts d ON d.id = od.discount_id AND d.tenant_id = od.tenant_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = od.order_id AND o.tenant_id = od.tenant_id
  WHERE d.name = 'Subscription delivery (prepaid)'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
    AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
),
rated AS (
  SELECT do.*,
         er.rate,
         do.subtotal / er.rate AS subtotal_eur,
         do.discount_total / er.rate AS discount_total_eur,
         do.tax_total / er.rate AS tax_total_eur,
         do.shipping_total / er.rate AS shipping_total_eur,
         do.grand_total / er.rate AS grand_total_eur,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
           WHERE s.tenant_id = do.tenant_id
             AND s.user_id = do.user_id
             AND s.status IN ('trialing','active','past_due')
             AND s.started_at <= do.placed_at
             AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= do.placed_at)
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_active_sub
  FROM disc_orders do
  JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er.quote_code = do.currency_code
   AND er.as_of = CAST(do.placed_at AS date)
)
SELECT
  t.name AS tenant_name,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) AS distinct_customers,
  ROUND(AVG(r.subtotal_eur),2) AS avg_subtotal_eur,
  ROUND(AVG(r.discount_total_eur),2) AS avg_discount_total_eur,
  ROUND(AVG(r.shipping_total_eur),2) AS avg_shipping_total_eur,
  ROUND(AVG(r.tax_total_eur),2) AS avg_tax_total_eur,
  ROUND(AVG(r.grand_total_eur),2) AS avg_grand_total_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.grand_total = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_zero_grand_total,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(r.has_active_sub) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_orders_with_active_subscription
FROM rated r
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = r.tenant_id
GROUP BY t.name
ORDER BY order_count DESC, tenant_name ASC
